'''Howling Woods''' is a {{MCD2|location}} in the {{MCD2|Overworld}} containing {{MCD2|Little Howl Hamlet}} and the cave that leads to {{MCD2|the Deep Dark}}. It is an [[old growth taiga]] biome infected with {{MCD2|sculk}}.

== Quests ==

=== Core quests ===
* {{MCD2|The Silence in Little Howl}}
* {{MCD2|Training with the Enchantsmith}}
* {{MCD2|Corruption in the Woods}}
* {{MCD2|Down into the Deep Dark}}

=== Side quests ===
* {{MCD2|Part of the Pack}}
* {{MCD2|The Cleric's Apprentice}}

== Mobs ==

The following friendlies can be encountered here:

* {{MCD2Link|Woods Wolf}}
* {{MCD2Link|Villager}}
